-- ── Strings (GlobalStrings.lua, verbatim) ─────────────────────────────────────────────── FRIENDS_LIST = "Friends List" -- l.1991 IGNORE_LIST = "Ignore List" -- l.2306 WHO_LIST = "Who List" -- l.5440 FRIENDS_LIST_TEMPLATE = "%s |cffffffff- %s|r %s" -- l.1993 FRIENDS_LIST_OFFLINE_TEMPLATE = "|cff999999%s - Offline|r" -- l.1992 FRIENDS_LEVEL_TEMPLATE = "Level %d %s" -- l.1990 WHO_FRAME_TOTAL_TEMPLATE = "%d Person Found" -- l.5438 WHO_FRAME_TOTAL_TEMPLATE_P1 = "%d People Found" -- l.5439 WHO_FRAME_SHOWN_TEMPLATE = "(%d displayed)" -- l.5437 WHO_TAG_ZONE = "z-" -- l.5449 ADD_FRIEND = "Add Friend" -- l.34 ADD_FRIEND_LABEL = "Enter name of friend to add:" -- l.35 REMOVE_FRIEND = "Remove Friend" -- l.3315 SEND_MESSAGE = "Send Message" -- l.3414 GROUP_INVITE = "Group Invite" -- l.2031 IGNORE_PLAYER = "Ignore Player" -- l.2307 ADD_IGNORE_LABEL = ADD_IGNORE_LABEL or "Enter name of player to ignore:" STOP_IGNORE = "Remove Player" -- l.4202 UNKNOWN = "Unknown" -- l.4443
-- The ref's own display constants (FriendsFrame.lua l.1-10). FRIENDS_TO_DISPLAY = 10 FRIENDS_FRAME_FRIEND_HEIGHT = 34 IGNORES_TO_DISPLAY = 20 FRIENDS_FRAME_IGNORE_HEIGHT = 16 WHOS_TO_DISPLAY = 17 FRIENDS_FRAME_WHO_HEIGHT = 16 MAX_WHOS_FROM_SERVER = 50
-- The who list's variable column (l.18-22): the dropdown picks which of the three the -- middle column shows, and its `sortType` is what the header sort sends. WHOFRAME_DROPDOWN_LIST = { { name = "Zone", sortType = "zone" }, { name = "Guild", sortType = "guild" }, { name = "Race", sortType = "race" }, }
BENILLA_FRIENDS_SUBFRAMES = { "FriendsListFrame", "IgnoreListFrame", "WhoFrame", }
-- ── Sub-frame switching (ref FriendsFrame_ShowSubFrame l.25-33) ──────────────────────── function FriendsFrame_ShowSubFrame(frameName) for i = 1, table.getn(BENILLA_FRIENDS_SUBFRAMES) do local value = BENILLA_FRIENDS_SUBFRAMES[i] if value == frameName then getglobal(value):Show() else getglobal(value):Hide() end end end
-- ── The row right-click menu (ref FriendsFrame_ShowDropdown l.35-47) ─────────────────── -- A row's right-click opens the shared UnitPopup "FRIEND" menu addressed by NAME rather -- than by a unit token — which is the whole reason that menu exists: a friend or a /who -- hit is a name with no unit behind it (they need not even be in the world). The kit -- already supports that shape (`UnitPopup_ShowMenu(menu, which, unit, name)`), and its -- WHISPER/INVITE rows fall back to the by-name calls when `unit` is nil. -- -- `connected` gates the whole menu, ref-verbatim: there is nothing to offer an offline -- player. A /who hit is by definition online, so that call passes 1. function BenillaFriendsFrame_ShowDropdown(name, connected) HideDropDownMenu(1) if not connected or not name or name == "" then return end BenillaFriendsDropDown.initialize = BenillaFriendsFrameDropDown_Initialize BenillaFriendsDropDown.displayMode = "MENU" BenillaFriendsDropDown.name = name ToggleDropDownMenu(1, nil, BenillaFriendsDropDown, "cursor") end
function BenillaFriendsFrameDropDown_Initialize() UnitPopup_ShowMenu(getglobal(UIDROPDOWNMENU_OPEN_MENU), "FRIEND", nil, BenillaFriendsDropDown.name) end
-- ── The window's repaint (ref FriendsFrame_Update l.81-126) ──────────────────────────── -- Each tab swaps the four corner art textures as well as the sub-frame: the ref reuses one -- 384x512 window shell for lists that want different bottom art. function FriendsFrame_Update() local frame = FriendsFrame if frame.selectedTab == 1 then FriendsFrameTopLeft:SetTexture("Interface\\PaperDollInfoFrame\\UI-Character-General-TopLeft") FriendsFrameTopRight:SetTexture("Interface\\PaperDollInfoFrame\\UI-Character-General-TopRight") if frame.showFriendsList then FriendsFrameBottomLeft:SetTexture("Interface\\FriendsFrame\\UI-FriendsFrame-BotLeft") FriendsFrameBottomRight:SetTexture("Interface\\FriendsFrame\\UI-FriendsFrame-BotRight") FriendsFrameTitleText:SetText(FRIENDS_LIST) FriendsList_Update() FriendsFrame_ShowSubFrame("FriendsListFrame") else FriendsFrameBottomLeft:SetTexture("Interface\\FriendsFrame\\UI-IgnoreFrame-BotLeft") FriendsFrameBottomRight:SetTexture("Interface\\FriendsFrame\\UI-IgnoreFrame-BotRight") FriendsFrameTitleText:SetText(IGNORE_LIST) IgnoreList_Update() FriendsFrame_ShowSubFrame("IgnoreListFrame") end elseif frame.selectedTab == 2 then FriendsFrameTopLeft:SetTexture("Interface\\ClassTrainerFrame\\UI-ClassTrainer-TopLeft") FriendsFrameTopRight:SetTexture("Interface\\ClassTrainerFrame\\UI-ClassTrainer-TopRight") FriendsFrameBottomLeft:SetTexture("Interface\\FriendsFrame\\WhoFrame-BotLeft") FriendsFrameBottomRight:SetTexture("Interface\\FriendsFrame\\WhoFrame-BotRight") FriendsFrameTitleText:SetText(WHO_LIST) WhoList_Update() FriendsFrame_ShowSubFrame("WhoFrame") end end
-- ── The friends list (ref FriendsList_Update l.142-210) ──────────────────────────────── function FriendsList_Update() local frame = FriendsFrame local numFriends = GetNumFriends() frame.selectedFriend = GetSelectedFriend()
-- The three action buttons follow the SELECTED friend, not the list: offline friends -- can be removed but not whispered or invited (ref l.154-172). if numFriends > 0 then if frame.selectedFriend == 0 then SetSelectedFriend(1) frame.selectedFriend = GetSelectedFriend() end local _, _, _, _, connected = GetFriendInfo(frame.selectedFriend) if connected then FriendsFrameSendMessageButton:Enable() FriendsFrameGroupInviteButton:Enable() else FriendsFrameSendMessageButton:Disable() FriendsFrameGroupInviteButton:Disable() end FriendsFrameRemoveFriendButton:Enable() else FriendsFrameSendMessageButton:Disable() FriendsFrameGroupInviteButton:Disable() FriendsFrameRemoveFriendButton:Disable() end
local offset = FauxScrollFrame_GetOffset(FriendsFrameFriendsScrollFrame) for i = 1, FRIENDS_TO_DISPLAY do local index = offset + i local name, level, class, area, connected, status = GetFriendInfo(index) local nameLocation = getglobal("FriendsFrameFriendButton" .. i .. "NameLocation") local info = getglobal("FriendsFrameFriendButton" .. i .. "Info") if not name or name == "" then name = UNKNOWN end if connected then nameLocation:SetText(format(FRIENDS_LIST_TEMPLATE, name, area, status or "")) info:SetText(format(FRIENDS_LEVEL_TEMPLATE, level, class)) else nameLocation:SetText(format(FRIENDS_LIST_OFFLINE_TEMPLATE, name)) info:SetText(UNKNOWN) end
local button = getglobal("FriendsFrameFriendButton" .. i) button:SetID(index) if index == frame.selectedFriend then button:LockHighlight() else button:UnlockHighlight() end if index > numFriends then button:Hide() else button:Show() end end
FauxScrollFrame_Update(FriendsFrameFriendsScrollFrame, numFriends, FRIENDS_TO_DISPLAY, FRIENDS_FRAME_FRIEND_HEIGHT) end
-- ── The ignore list (ref IgnoreList_Update l.212-251) ────────────────────────────────── function IgnoreList_Update() local frame = FriendsFrame local numIgnores = GetNumIgnores() frame.selectedIgnore = GetSelectedIgnore() if numIgnores > 0 then if frame.selectedIgnore == 0 then SetSelectedIgnore(1) frame.selectedIgnore = GetSelectedIgnore() end FriendsFrameStopIgnoreButton:Enable() else FriendsFrameStopIgnoreButton:Disable() end
local offset = FauxScrollFrame_GetOffset(FriendsFrameIgnoreScrollFrame) for i = 1, IGNORES_TO_DISPLAY do local index = offset + i getglobal("FriendsFrameIgnoreButton" .. i .. "Name") :SetText(GetIgnoreName(index) or "") local button = getglobal("FriendsFrameIgnoreButton" .. i) button:SetID(index) if index == frame.selectedIgnore then button:LockHighlight() else button:UnlockHighlight() end if index > numIgnores then button:Hide() else button:Show() end end
FauxScrollFrame_Update(FriendsFrameIgnoreScrollFrame, numIgnores, IGNORES_TO_DISPLAY, FRIENDS_FRAME_IGNORE_HEIGHT) end
-- ── The who list (ref WhoList_Update l.253-325) ──────────────────────────────────────── function WhoList_Update() local numWhos, totalCount = GetNumWhoResults() local frame = WhoFrame
-- "132 People Found (50 displayed)" — the suffix appears only when the server -- matched more than it could send (ref l.264-268). local displayedText = "" if totalCount > MAX_WHOS_FROM_SERVER then displayedText = format(WHO_FRAME_SHOWN_TEMPLATE, MAX_WHOS_FROM_SERVER) end local totalTemplate = WHO_FRAME_TOTAL_TEMPLATE_P1 if totalCount == 1 then totalTemplate = WHO_FRAME_TOTAL_TEMPLATE end WhoFrameTotals:SetText(format(totalTemplate, totalCount) .. " " .. displayedText)
local showScrollBar = nil if numWhos > WHOS_TO_DISPLAY then showScrollBar = 1 end local column = UIDropDownMenu_GetSelectedID(WhoFrameDropDown) or 1 local offset = FauxScrollFrame_GetOffset(WhoListScrollFrame) for i = 1, WHOS_TO_DISPLAY do local index = offset + i local button = getglobal("WhoFrameButton" .. i) button.whoIndex = index local name, guild, level, race, class, zone = GetWhoInfo(index) getglobal("WhoFrameButton" .. i .. "Name"):SetText(name or "") getglobal("WhoFrameButton" .. i .. "Level"):SetText(level or "") getglobal("WhoFrameButton" .. i .. "Class"):SetText(class or "") -- The variable column follows the dropdown: zone / guild / race (ref l.274-279). local columnTable = { zone, guild, race } local variable = getglobal("WhoFrameButton" .. i .. "Variable") variable:SetText(columnTable[column] or "") if showScrollBar then variable:SetWidth(95) else variable:SetWidth(110) end
if frame.selectedWho == index then button:LockHighlight() else button:UnlockHighlight() end if index > numWhos then button:Hide() else button:Show() end end
-- The two who buttons need a selected row (ref l.302-309). if not frame.selectedWho then WhoFrameGroupInviteButton:Disable() WhoFrameAddFriendButton:Disable() else WhoFrameGroupInviteButton:Enable() WhoFrameAddFriendButton:Enable() frame.selectedName = GetWhoInfo(frame.selectedWho) end
-- The middle column and the dropdown narrow to make room for the bar (ref l.311-318). if showScrollBar then WhoFrameColumn_SetWidth(105, WhoFrameColumnHeader2) UIDropDownMenu_SetWidth(80, WhoFrameDropDown) else WhoFrameColumn_SetWidth(120, WhoFrameColumnHeader2) UIDropDownMenu_SetWidth(95, WhoFrameDropDown) end
FauxScrollFrame_Update(WhoListScrollFrame, numWhos, WHOS_TO_DISPLAY, FRIENDS_FRAME_WHO_HEIGHT) end
-- Ref WhoFrameColumn_SetWidth l.605-611: the header's middle slice carries the width less -- the two 9px end caps. function WhoFrameColumn_SetWidth(width, frame) frame:SetWidth(width) getglobal(frame:GetName() .. "Middle"):SetWidth(width - 9) end
-- ── The who column dropdown (ref WhoFrameDropDown_* l.613-633) ───────────────────────── function WhoFrameDropDown_Initialize() for i = 1, table.getn(WHOFRAME_DROPDOWN_LIST) do local info = {} info.text = WHOFRAME_DROPDOWN_LIST[i].name info.func = WhoFrameDropDownButton_OnClick UIDropDownMenu_AddButton(info) end end
function WhoFrameDropDown_OnLoad() UIDropDownMenu_Initialize(this, WhoFrameDropDown_Initialize) UIDropDownMenu_SetWidth(80, this) UIDropDownMenu_SetButtonWidth(24, this) UIDropDownMenu_JustifyText("LEFT", this) end
function WhoFrameDropDownButton_OnClick() UIDropDownMenu_SetSelectedID(WhoFrameDropDown, this:GetID()) -- The ref sorts on the dropdown's OnMouseUp; doing it on the pick is the same intent -- with one fewer hook, and keeps the column and its sort in step. local entry = WHOFRAME_DROPDOWN_LIST[this:GetID()] if entry and entry.sortType then SortWho(entry.sortType) end WhoList_Update() end
-- ── Events (ref FriendsFrame_OnEvent l.635-662) ──────────────────────────────────────── function FriendsFrame_OnEvent() if event == "FRIENDLIST_SHOW" then FriendsList_Update() FriendsFrame_Update() elseif event == "FRIENDLIST_UPDATE" then FriendsList_Update() elseif event == "IGNORELIST_UPDATE" then IgnoreList_Update() elseif event == "WHO_LIST_UPDATE" then -- A fresh answer drops the old selection: row 3 of the last query is not row 3 of -- this one, and the ref's own Refresh button clears it for exactly that reason. WhoFrame.selectedWho = nil WhoList_Update() end end
function FriendsFrame_OnLoad() PanelTemplates_SetNumTabs(this, 3) this.selectedTab = 1 this.showFriendsList = 1 this.selectedFriend = 0 this.selectedIgnore = 0 PanelTemplates_UpdateTabs(this) -- No guild arc yet, so the GUILD tab is what a guildless character sees: present, -- greyed, un-clickable (ref InGuildCheck l.920-931, the `not IsInGuild()` branch). PanelTemplates_DisableTab(this, 3) this:RegisterEvent("FRIENDLIST_SHOW") this:RegisterEvent("FRIENDLIST_UPDATE") this:RegisterEvent("IGNORELIST_UPDATE") this:RegisterEvent("WHO_LIST_UPDATE") end
function FriendsFrame_OnShow() FriendsFrame_Update() -- Guarded, the house idiom (CharacterFrame/QuestLogFrame do the same): MicroMenu.xml -- loads before this file in the real manifest, but a window must stay loadable on its -- own for its tests. if UpdateMicroButtons then UpdateMicroButtons() end PlaySound("igMainMenuOpen") end
function FriendsFrame_OnHide() if UpdateMicroButtons then UpdateMicroButtons() end PlaySound("igMainMenuClose") for i = 1, table.getn(BENILLA_FRIENDS_SUBFRAMES) do getglobal(BENILLA_FRIENDS_SUBFRAMES[i]):Hide() end end
-- ── Row clicks (ref l.664-688) ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────── function FriendsFrameFriendButton_OnClick(button) if button == "RightButton" then local name, _, _, _, connected = GetFriendInfo(this:GetID()) BenillaFriendsFrame_ShowDropdown(name, connected) return end SetSelectedFriend(this:GetID()) FriendsList_Update() end
function FriendsFrameIgnoreButton_OnClick() SetSelectedIgnore(this:GetID()) IgnoreList_Update() end
function FriendsFrameWhoButton_OnClick(button) local name = getglobal(this:GetName() .. "Name"):GetText() if button == "RightButton" then -- A /who hit is online by construction, so the menu is never gated shut here. BenillaFriendsFrame_ShowDropdown(name, 1) return end WhoFrame.selectedWho = this.whoIndex WhoFrame.selectedName = name WhoList_Update() end
-- ── The buttons (ref l.714-739) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────── function FriendsFrame_UnIgnore() local name = GetIgnoreName(FriendsFrame.selectedIgnore) if name then DelIgnore(name) end end
function FriendsFrame_RemoveFriend() if FriendsFrame.selectedFriend and FriendsFrame.selectedFriend > 0 then RemoveFriend(FriendsFrame.selectedFriend) end end
-- The ref opens the chat edit box prefilled "/w <name> " (l.726-734). benilla's chat edit -- box is app-side, so the same intent goes through `ChatFrame_SendTell`, the whisper-target -- queue the unit popup's WHISPER row already feeds. function FriendsFrame_SendMessage() local name = GetFriendInfo(FriendsFrame.selectedFriend) if name and name ~= "" then ChatFrame_SendTell(name) end end
function FriendsFrame_GroupInvite() local name = GetFriendInfo(FriendsFrame.selectedFriend) if name and name ~= "" then InviteByName(name) end end
-- ── The window verbs (ref ToggleFriendsFrame l.741-765, ShowWhoPanel l.772-779) ──────── -- `tab` nil = plain toggle; 1 = friends, 2 = who. Clicking the tab you are already on -- closes the window (the ref's own second branch). function ToggleFriendsFrame(tab) if not tab then if FriendsFrame:IsVisible() then HideUIPanel(FriendsFrame) else ShowUIPanel(FriendsFrame) end return end if tab == PanelTemplates_GetSelectedTab(FriendsFrame) and FriendsFrame:IsVisible() then HideUIPanel(FriendsFrame) return end PanelTemplates_SetTab(FriendsFrame, tab) if FriendsFrame:IsVisible() then FriendsFrame_OnShow() else ShowUIPanel(FriendsFrame) end end
function ShowWhoPanel() PanelTemplates_SetTab(FriendsFrame, 2) if FriendsFrame:IsVisible() then FriendsFrame_OnShow() else ShowUIPanel(FriendsFrame) end end
function ShowIgnorePanel() FriendsFrame.showFriendsList = nil PanelTemplates_SetTab(FriendsFrame, 1) if FriendsFrame:IsVisible() then FriendsFrame_OnShow() else ShowUIPanel(FriendsFrame) end end
-- The default `/who` (ref WhoFrame_GetDefaultWhoCommand l.790-798): this zone, my level -- ±3. function WhoFrame_GetDefaultWhoCommand() local level = UnitLevel("player") or 1 local minLevel = level - 3 if minLevel <= 0 then minLevel = 1 end return WHO_TAG_ZONE .. "\"" .. (GetRealZoneText() or "") .. "\" " .. minLevel .. "-" .. (level + 3) end
function WhoFrameEditBox_OnEnterPressed() SendWho(WhoFrameEditBox:GetText()) WhoFrameEditBox:ClearFocus() end
-- ── The slash bodies (ref ChatFrame.lua SlashCmdList l.1013-1062, verbatim) ──────────── -- benilla parses slash lines in Rust, so the app calls these rather than a SlashCmdList -- table — but the bodies are the ref's, so the window behaviour stays in the FrameXML. function BenillaSlashWho(msg) if msg == "" then msg = WhoFrame_GetDefaultWhoCommand() ShowWhoPanel() end WhoFrameEditBox:SetText(msg) SendWho(msg) end
function BenillaSlashFriends(msg) if msg ~= "" then AddFriend(msg) else ShowFriends() end end
function BenillaSlashRemoveFriend(msg) if msg ~= "" then RemoveFriend(msg) end end
function BenillaSlashIgnore(msg) if msg ~= "" then AddOrDelIgnore(msg) else ShowIgnorePanel() end end
function BenillaSlashUnignore(msg) if msg ~= "" then DelIgnore(msg) else ShowIgnorePanel() end end
-- ── The two name-entry dialogs (ref StaticPopup.lua l.775-820) ───────────────────────── -- The first customers of the popup engine's hasEditBox capability (decision 0668). StaticPopupDialogs["ADD_FRIEND"] = { text = ADD_FRIEND_LABEL, button1 = "Accept", button2 = "Cancel", hasEditBox = 1, maxLetters = 12, OnAccept = function() AddFriend(getglobal("StaticPopup1EditBox"):GetText()) end, OnShow = function() getglobal("StaticPopup1EditBox"):SetFocus() end, EditBoxOnEnterPressed = function() AddFriend(getglobal("StaticPopup1EditBox"):GetText()) StaticPopup_Hide("ADD_FRIEND") end, timeout = 0, hideOnEscape = 1, }
StaticPopupDialogs["ADD_IGNORE"] = { text = ADD_IGNORE_LABEL, button1 = "Accept", button2 = "Cancel", hasEditBox = 1, maxLetters = 12, OnAccept = function() AddIgnore(getglobal("StaticPopup1EditBox"):GetText()) end, OnShow = function() getglobal("StaticPopup1EditBox"):SetFocus() end, EditBoxOnEnterPressed = function() AddIgnore(getglobal("StaticPopup1EditBox"):GetText()) StaticPopup_Hide("ADD_IGNORE") end, timeout = 0, hideOnEscape = 1, }

Scripts.OnClick: if this.sortType then SortWho(this.sortType) end PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn")
if UnitCanCooperate("player", "target") then AddFriend(UnitName("target")) else StaticPopup_Show("ADD_FRIEND") end
